claim: On June 12, 2024 ElastiCache Serverless added snapshot and restore for Memcached. Previously customers running Memcached workloads on ElastiCache did not have the ability to backup or preserve their data in the event of a failure, data loss, or data migration.
question: Does ElastiCache Memcached support snapshots and restore, and since when?

values.display: did not have the ability to backup or preserve their data
values.spoken: could not back up or preserve their data

values.display: Backup and restore are supported only for caches running on Valkey, Redis OSS or Serverless Memcached
values.spoken: backup and restore only for Valkey, Redis OSS and serverless Memcached

evidence.quote: Previously customers running Memcached workloads on ElastiCache did not have the ability to backup or preserve their data in the event of a failure, data loss, or data migration.
Backup and restore are supported only for caches running on Valkey, Redis OSS or Serverless Memcached.

changed.was: did not have the ability to backup or preserve their data in the event of a failure, data loss, or data migration

note: What's New post of 2024-06-12 (Amazon ElastiCache Serverless now supports snapshot and restore for Memcached). Node-based Memcached clusters still have no backup (see the engine comparison row: for serverless caches only, not applicable to node-based clusters).

claim: With the ElastiCache integration with Service Quotas, announced in a What's New post, the integration enables automated limit increase approvals for eligible requests, improving response times and reducing the number of support tickets.
question: Can ElastiCache quota increases be requested through Service Quotas, and are they approved automatically?

values.display: automated limit increase approvals for eligible requests
values.spoken: automatic approval of eligible limit increases

evidence.quote: This integration enables automated limit increase approvals for eligible requests, improving response times and reducing the number of support tickets.

note: Dated 2025-01-15 in the change feed (title: Amazon ElastiCache now supports Service Quotas). The quotas guide page points to the Service Quotas console.
